mapper.insert:
select club_seq.nextval from dual
insert into club( club_no, club_leader, club_name, club_introduce, region_no, category_no, club_profile, club_max, club_count, club_open ) values( #{clubNo}, #{clubLeader}, #{clubName}, #{clubIntroduce}, #{regionNo}, #{categoryNo}, #{clubProfile}, #{clubMax}, 1, #{clubOpen} )
mapper.select: SELECT C.*, R.region_name AS regionName, CAT.category_name AS categoryName FROM club C LEFT JOIN region R ON C.region_no = R.region_no LEFT JOIN category CAT ON C.category_no = CAT.category_no WHERE C.club_no = #{clubNo}
